# IMinimalVestingFactory
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/IMinimalVestingFactory.sol)

**Title:**
IMinimalVestingFactory

Minimal vesting factory interface exposing the wallet/owner lookups used by the escrow


## Functions
### vestingWallets

Returns the vesting wallet deployed for a given user

each user can have a single vesting wallet - the balance of the vesting wallet can only go down


```solidity
function vestingWallets(address _user) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_user`|`address`|The user whose vesting wallet address is queried|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the user's vesting wallet (or the zero address if none)|


### vestingWalletOwners

Returns the owner recorded for a given vesting wallet

the owner of the vesting wallet


```solidity
function vestingWalletOwners(address _wallet) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_wallet`|`address`|The vesting wallet address whose owner is queried|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address recorded as the owner of the wallet|
